paragraph:
This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Answer.**
Three of the four schools within 1,500 meters of 116-02 Rockaway Beach Boulevard are also modeled to be inside the NYC DEP extreme stormwater scenario for 2080 sea-level rise, further confirming flood exposure [dep_extreme_2080][doe_school_exposure].

**Hazard Reader.**
The address is inside FEMA flood zone X, per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970379F, effective 2007 [fema_nfhl]. The address is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenarios for 2080 SLR, 2050 SLR, and current SLR [dep_extreme_2080][dep_moderate_2050][dep_moderate_current].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
